issues.detail: The Greek word 'αδελφαι' (adelphai) is the feminine plural of 'adelphos'. While it can mean 'sisters', in the context of the New Testament (specifically John 1:12), it refers to 'children' or 'offspring' (the children of God). Translating it as 'chị em gái' (sisters) is a gender-specific restriction not present in the Greek, which would lead a Vietnamese reader to miss the inclusive meaning of 'children'.
